items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the author's theorem characterizing DM algebraic stacks through the existence of a surjective etale morphism from a scheme (source lines 4588-4597, label theorem-DM); the author's own proof at source lines 4599-4739 follows it immediately and is its proof. The proof produces, at each finite type point, a scheme etale over the stack and covering a neighbourhood: it uses the residual gerbe, the field-valued etale cover of a one-point DM stack, the etale diagonal of a presentation, the slice lemma to cut out a regular sequence and the local criterion for etaleness, and finishes by taking the disjoint union over all finite type points and applying the density of finite type points (proof lines 4599-4738). This is one of the two structural theorems of the chapter. H3.
